# Figures for paper {.unnumbered}

This is just the template - not finished.

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
environ <- readr::read_tsv("data/raw_data/environment.tsv")
params <- read_csv("data/derived_data/params_flux_all.csv")

site_info <- read.csv("data/derived_data/sites_to_keep.csv") |>
  filter(ncensus >= 10) |>
  mutate(
    continent =
      case_when(
        Site %in% c("Corinto", "Paracou", "Tapajos Km67")
        ~ "America",
        Site %in% c("Lesong", "SUAS", "Sungai Lalang", "Ulu Muda")
        ~ "Asia",
        Site %in% c("Mbaiki")
        ~ "Africa"
      )
  ) |>
  left_join(environ, by = c("Site" = "site"))

plot_info_raw <- read.csv("data/raw_data/bioforest-plot-information.csv") |>
  select(site, plot, Year_of_harvest, Treatment)

plot_info <- read_csv("data/derived_data/aggregated_data_v10.csv") |>
  filter(Site %in% site_info$Site & variable %in% c("ba", "agb")) |>
  mutate(plot_new = Plot) |>
  separate(Plot, "Plot", "_") |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = "variable",
    values_from = "value"
  ) |>
  left_join(plot_info_raw, by = join_by(Site == site, Plot == plot)) |>
  group_by(Site, plot_new, Treatment, Year_of_harvest) |>
  summarise(
    census1 = min(Year),
    ba_0 = ba[Year == min(Year)],
    ba_min = min(ba[Year > Year_of_harvest &
                      Year <= Year_of_harvest + 5]),
    agb_0 = agb[Year == min(Year)]
  ) |>
  mutate(
    ba_0 = if_else(census1 < Year_of_harvest, ba_0, NA),
    agb_0 = if_else(census1 < Year_of_harvest, agb_0, NA),
    intensity = (ba_0 - ba_min) / ba_0
  )


data_explo <- params |>
  left_join(site_info) |>
  left_join(plot_info)
```

## Modelled trajectories

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
plot_info <- read.csv("data/raw_data/bioforest-plot-information.csv") |>
  left_join(read.csv("data/raw_data/plot_correspondance.csv")) |>
  select(site, plot = new_plot, Year_of_harvest, Treatment) |>
  unique()


data <- read.csv("data/derived_data/aggregated_data_v10.csv") |>
  left_join(plot_info, by = join_by(Site == site, Plot == plot)) |>
  filter(grepl("^agb", variable) & !grepl("]$", variable)) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = "variable", values_from = "value") |>
  mutate(prod = agb_growth + agb_recr, mort = agb_mort, stocks = agb) |>
  select(!contains("agb")) |>
  group_by(Site, plot_new = Plot) |>
  arrange(Year) |>
  mutate(tdiff = c(0, diff(Year))) |>
  ungroup() |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c("stocks", "prod", "mort"), names_to = "variable") |>
  mutate(Year_of_harvest = ifelse(Site == "Mbaiki" & Treatment == "Logging",
    1985, Year_of_harvest
  )) |>
  mutate(Year_of_harvest = ifelse(Site == "Paracou" & Treatment == "Logging",
    1987, Year_of_harvest
  )) |>
  mutate(trec = Year - Year_of_harvest) |>
  filter(!(Site == "Tapajos Km67" &
             grepl("loggedtwice", Plot) & Year > 2014)) |>
  filter(!(Site == "Tapajos Km67" & grepl("later", Plot)))


sites <- read.csv("data/derived_data/sites_to_keep.csv") |>
  filter(ncensus >= 10)
data <- data |>
  filter(Site %in% sites$Site)


data_rec <- data |>
  mutate(sitenum = as.numeric(as.factor(Site))) |>
  subset(Treatment == "Logging" & trec > 0) |>
  # problem with first years in SUAS: excessive prod. because of  DBH increases
  filter(!(Site == "SUAS" & trec < 3 & variable == "prod")) |>
  filter(!(Site == "Tapajos Km67" &
             Plot %in% c(1:12, paste0(1:12, "E")) &
             Year >= 2014)) |> # remove second logging event in Tapajos
  pivot_wider(names_from = "variable", values_from = "value") |>
  subset(!is.na(prod) & !is.na(mort)) |>
  mutate(plotnum = as.numeric(as.factor(paste(Site, plot_new))))
data_old <- data |>
  mutate(sitenum = as.numeric(as.factor(Site))) |>
  subset(Treatment == "Control" | trec < 0) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = "variable", values_from = "value") |>
  subset(!is.na(prod) & !is.na(mort))

  
fit_flux_all <- as_cmdstan_fit(
  list.files("chains/flux_all_simpl_Ksite_nohyper/", full.names = TRUE)
)
fit_flux_all

pred_data <- data_rec |>
  select(-plotnum) |>
  mutate(
    prod = fit_flux_all$summary(c("mu_in_log"), median)$median,
    mort = fit_flux_all$summary(c("mu_out_log"), median)$median,
    val = "pred",
    type = "rec"
  ) |>
  rbind(mutate(
    data_old,
    prod = fit_flux_all$summary(c("theta_s"), median)$median[data_old$sitenum] * # nolint
      fit_flux_all$summary(c("omega_s"), median)$median[data_old$sitenum], # nolint
    mort = fit_flux_all$summary(c("theta_s"), median)$median[data_old$sitenum] * # nolint
      fit_flux_all$summary(c("omega_s"), median)$median[data_old$sitenum], # nolint
    val = "pred",
    type = "equ"
  ))

obs_data <- data_rec |>
  mutate(
    val = "obs",
    type = "rec"
  ) |>
  select(-plotnum) |>
  rbind(mutate(
    data_old,
    val = "obs",
    type = "equ"
  ))

pov_data <- rbind(pred_data, obs_data) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(prod, mort), names_to = "variable") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = val, values_from = value)
```

### Productivity

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 12
#| fig-cap: "Predicted trajectories."

controls <- 
  pov_data |>
  subset(variable == "prod") |>
  mutate(Plot = plot_new) |>
  group_by(Site) |>
  mutate(tmin = min(trec[type == "rec"]), tmax = max(trec[type == "rec"])) |>
  filter(type == "equ") |>
  mutate(trec = ifelse(Treatment == "Logging", tmin - 2, tmax + 2))

pov_data |>
  subset(variable == "prod") |>
  mutate(Plot = plot_new) |>
  mutate(across(c(Plot), factor)) |> 
  filter(type == "rec") |>
  ggplot(aes(trec, y = obs)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Plot, col = Plot, y = pred), size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(aes(group = Plot, col = Plot, alpha = .5)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Plot, col = Plot, alpha = .5)) +
  geom_boxplot(data = controls, aes(group = Treatment), width = 2) +
  xlab("Recovery time (years)") +
  ylab(expression("AGB productivity ("~Mg ~ ha^-1 ~ yr^-1~")")) +
  scale_colour_discrete(palette = rep(colorBlindness::SteppedSequential5Steps, times = 10)) +
  theme_classic()+
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(alpha(colour = "lightgrey", .5), linewidth = .1),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_line(alpha(colour = "lightgrey", .5), linewidth = .1),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(alpha(colour = "lightgrey", .5), linewidth = .1),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_line(alpha(colour = "lightgrey", .5), linewidth = .1),
    text = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.placement = "outside")+
  facet_wrap(~Site, scales = "free", ncol = 2)

ggsave(file = "figures/traj_prod.png", height = 12, width = 10)
```

## Magnitude of AGB changes associated with demographic processes (how much?)

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

tmp <- data.table::as.data.table(data_explo)[!is.na(agb_0)]
tmp$site_plot <- paste(tmp$Site, tmp$plot_new)
data.table::setnames(tmp, c("continent"), "Continent")


p_p1 <- 
  ggplot(
    tmp[variable == "stpp"], 
    aes(median * 100 / agb_0,
        reorder(site_plot, median * 100 / agb_0),
        col = factor(Site, c("Corinto", "Paracou", "Mbaiki", "SUAS")),
        shape = factor(Continent, c("America", "Africa", "Asia"))
    ),
    show.legend = F
  )+
  geom_pointrange(
    aes(
      xmin = q5 * 100 / agb_0,
      xmax = q95 * 100 / agb_0
    ),
    show.legend = F
  )+
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = median(tmp[variable == "stpp"]$median / tmp[variable == "stpp"]$agb_0 * 100),
    linetype = 2
  )+
  labs(
    x = "AGB over-productivity\n[% prelogging AGB]",
    y = "Permanent plot"
  )+
  guides(shape = guide_legend(title = "Continent", order = 1), colour = guide_legend(order = 2))+
  scale_colour_discrete(name = "Site", palette = c("#C0C000", "#008000", "#A25100", "#4151B0"))+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(alpha(colour = "lightgrey", .5), linewidth = .1),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_line(alpha(colour = "lightgrey", .5), linewidth = .1),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    text = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16)
  )


p_m1 <- 
  ggplot(
    tmp[variable == "stpm"], 
    aes(median * 100 / agb_0,
        reorder(site_plot, median * 100 / agb_0),
        col = factor(Site, c("Corinto", "Paracou", "Mbaiki", "SUAS")),
        shape = factor(Continent, c("America", "Africa", "Asia"))
    )
  )+
  geom_pointrange(
    aes(
      xmin = q5 * 100 / agb_0,
      xmax = q95 * 100 / agb_0
    )
  )+
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = median(tmp[variable == "stpm"]$median / tmp[variable == "stpm"]$agb_0 * 100),
    linetype = 2
  )+
  labs(
    x = "AGB over-mortality\n[% prelogging AGB]",
    y = "",
    size = "Continent"
  )+
  guides(shape = guide_legend(title = "Continent", order = 1), colour = guide_legend(order = 2))+
  scale_colour_discrete(name = "Site", palette = c("#C0C000", "#008000", "#A25100", "#4151B0"))+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(alpha(colour = "lightgrey", .5), linewidth = .1),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_line(alpha(colour = "lightgrey", .5), linewidth = .1),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    text = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16)
  )

library(patchwork)
(p_p1|p_m1)+
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")
ggsave(file = "figures/magnitude.pdf", height = 9.5, width = 11)
rm(tmp, p_p1, p_m1)
```

### Climate

#### Over-productivity

```{r}
tmp <- 
  data_explo  |> 
  filter(variable == "stpp" & !(is.na(agb_0))) |>
  select(
    Site, plot_new, median, q5, q95, agb_0,
    continent,
    et, cwd, pr, tmax, vpd, soil, dsl, dsi
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(et:dsi, names_to = "var_clim", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(
    var_clim = 
      fct_recode(
        var_clim,
        "Evapotranspiration, mm" = "et",
        "Climate water deficit, mm" = "cwd",
        "Precipitation, mm" = "pr",
        "Maximum temperature, °C" = "tmax",
        "Vapour Pressure Deficit, kPa" = "vpd",
        "Soil humidity, mm" = "soil",
        "Dry season length, days" = "dsl",
        "Dry season intensity, mm" = "dsi"
      )
  )


ggplot(
  tmp,
  aes(
    x = value, 
    y = median * 100 / agb_0
  )
)+
  geom_pointrange(
    aes(
      ymin = q5 * 100 / agb_0,
      ymax = q95 * 100 / agb_0,
      col = factor(Site, c("Corinto", "Paracou", "Mbaiki", "SUAS")),
      shape = factor(continent, c("America", "Africa", "Asia"))
    )
  )+
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm", se = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.5, col = alpha("darkgrey", 0.7), linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "AGB over-productivity [% prelogging AGB]"
  ) +
  guides(shape = guide_legend(title = "Continent", order = 1), colour = guide_legend(order = 2))+
  scale_colour_discrete(name = "Site", palette = c("#C0C000", "#008000", "#A25100", "#4151B0"))+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(alpha(colour = "lightgrey", .5), linewidth = .1),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_line(alpha(colour = "lightgrey", .5), linewidth = .1),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(alpha(colour = "lightgrey", .5), linewidth = .1),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_line(alpha(colour = "lightgrey", .5), linewidth = .1),
    text = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.placement = "outside"
  )+
  facet_wrap(~var_clim, scales = "free_x", strip.position = "bottom")

ggsave(file = "figures/environment_prod.pdf", height = 8, width = 10)
rm(tmp)
```

#### Over-mortality

```{r}
tmp <- 
  data_explo  |> 
  filter(variable == "stpm" & !(is.na(agb_0))) |>
  select(
    Site, plot_new, median, q5, q95, agb_0,
    continent,
    et, cwd, pr, tmax, vpd, soil, dsl, dsi
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(et:dsi, names_to = "var_clim", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(
    var_clim = 
      fct_recode(
        var_clim,
        "Evapotranspiration, mm" = "et",
        "Climate water deficit, mm" = "cwd",
        "Precipitation, mm" = "pr",
        "Maximum temperature, °C" = "tmax",
        "Vapour Pressure Deficit, kPa" = "vpd",
        "Soil humidity, mm" = "soil",
        "Dry season length, days" = "dsl",
        "Dry season intensity, mm" = "dsi"
      )
  )


ggplot(
  tmp,
  aes(
    x = value, 
    y = median * 100 / agb_0
  )
)+
  geom_pointrange(
    aes(
      ymin = q5 * 100 / agb_0,
      ymax = q95 * 100 / agb_0,
      col = factor(Site, c("Corinto", "Paracou", "Mbaiki", "SUAS")),
      shape = factor(continent, c("America", "Africa", "Asia"))
    )
  )+
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm", se = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.5, col = alpha("darkgrey", 0.7), linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "AGB over-mortality [% prelogging AGB]"
  ) +
  guides(shape = guide_legend(title = "Continent", order = 1), colour = guide_legend(order = 2))+
  scale_colour_discrete(name = "Site", palette = c("#C0C000", "#008000", "#A25100", "#4151B0"))+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(alpha(colour = "lightgrey", .5), linewidth = .1),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_line(alpha(colour = "lightgrey", .5), linewidth = .1),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(alpha(colour = "lightgrey", .5), linewidth = .1),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_line(alpha(colour = "lightgrey", .5), linewidth = .1),
    text = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.placement = "outside"
  )+
  facet_wrap(~var_clim, scales = "free_x", strip.position = "bottom")

ggsave(file = "figures/environment_mort.pdf", height = 8, width = 10)
rm(tmp)
```
